note.zh-TW: 模板寫「負債比例」；年報的財務分析稱負債占資產比率。課程的門檻只當「課程參考值」顯示，不計分（設計說明見 T24）；與權益倍數的換算關係在解說中補上（設計說明見 T38）。
note.en: The template says debt proportion; annual reports call it the liabilities to assets ratio. The course threshold is shown only as a course reference value and is not scored (see the design note T24); the conversion to the equity multiplier is given in the explanation (see the design note T38).

definition.zh-TW: 負債總額占資產總計的比率，衡量公司的資產有多少是靠借來的錢撐起來的。數值越高，財務風險越大；越低表示靠股東的錢比較多。
definition.en: Total liabilities as a share of total assets: how much of the company's assets are funded by borrowed money. A higher value means more financial risk; a lower value means more of the funding comes from shareholders.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
